verses.text: So what are we saying, fam—keep sinning so grace can keep overflowing?
No way! We died to sin; how are we gonna keep living in it?
Don’t you know that when we were baptized into Christ Jesus, we were baptized into his death too?
So through baptism we were buried with him into death. And just as the Father’s glory raised Christ from the dead, we get to walk in a brand-new life. 🌅
If we’ve been joined with him in a death like his, we’ll share in his resurrection too.
Here’s the deal: our old self was nailed to the cross with him, so sin’s grip on our body could be broken and we wouldn’t have to be sin’s slaves anymore.
Anyone who has died has been set free from sin.
If we died with Christ, we trust we’ll live with him too.
We know Christ was raised from the dead and won’t die again. Death has no claim on him now!
The death he died, he died to sin once and for all. The life he lives now, he lives for God.
So count yourselves dead to sin and alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord. 🙌
Don’t let sin run your mortal body like it owns the place. Don’t obey its cravings.
Don’t hand your body parts over to sin as tools for doing wrong. Hand yourselves to God as people brought from death to life, and let every part of you serve what’s right.
Sin won’t boss you around, because you’re under grace, not the Law.
So what’s the move—sin because we’re under grace instead of the Law? Absolutely not!
Don’t you know that when you hand yourself over to obey someone, you become their servant? You’re serving sin, which leads to death, or obedience, which leads to righteousness.
Thank God! You used to be sin’s slaves, but you followed the teaching you received from the heart.
You’ve been freed from sin and signed up to serve righteousness.

I’m putting this in everyday terms because our human weakness is real. You used to hand your bodies over to impurity and one wrong move after another. Now hand yourselves over to righteousness, and let God make you holy.
When sin was calling the shots, you weren’t doing what was right.
What did that old life actually produce? Stuff you’re ashamed of now—and its end is death.
But now you’re free from sin and serving God. The fruit you’re growing leads to holiness, and the finish line is eternal life. 🌱
Sin pays out death. But God gives eternal life as a gift in Christ Jesus our Lord. 🎁
